rows.subject: Wilfs Electric website
rows.body1:
Hey, my name is Kash. I build websites for local businesses.

I noticed yours was a bit outdated, so I made you a new homepage for free. Before and after is below.

Let me know if you like the idea of a new website and we can explore some options.

Thanks!
Kash
rows.body2:
Hey, just wanted to make sure this didn't get buried. Did you get a chance to look at the new homepage I made you? Happy to send over the full page if you want to see more.

Kash
rows.body3:
Hey, last one from me. If a new website isn't a priority right now, no worries at all. If it ever is, just reply here and I'll put some options together for you.

Thanks,
Kash
